body.statement:
For every \(\alpha\in(0,1)\), the independent-pilot construction satisfies
\[
 \liminf_{n\to\infty}\inf_{\mathbf P\in\mathfrak M}
 \Pr_{\mathbb P_n}\{\tau_n\in C_n^{\mathrm{ad}}(\alpha)\}
 \ge1-\alpha.
\]
This conclusion is uniform over all exact-close arrays, including root-\(n\)-local separations and multiple-close-donor faces, and its covariance calibration retains every shared treated-group and reused-control covariance encoded by \(A\).
body.justification: Pilot screening is useful only if it preserves honesty at local label collisions and on faces with several exact donors.
body.gap: Ordinary consistent model selection does not justify a confidence set uniformly over root-\(n\)-local score separations; independence and simultaneous main-sample calibration are both needed.
body.consumer: Applications may reduce the calibration menu using prespecified sample splitting without sacrificing the conditional uniform coverage guarantee.
